Name: Sword
Blurb: The all-rounder: quick, reliable hits. Swing right to left, then back left to right for a fast combo. A shield can be carried with it.

Name: Axe
Blurb: Hits harder than a sword and chops trees faster. Fights just as a sword does, swings, charge, low sweep and dash, away from a tree. A shield can be carried with it.

Name: Pickaxe
Blurb: A mining tool first and a weapon only in a pinch, though it fights as a sword does away from a rock. Better pickaxes mine faster and unlock harder ore.

Name: Spear
Blurb: Long reach. Hold the attack button to charge a lunge. A shield can be carried with it.

Name: Broadsword
Blurb: A heavy two-handed blade: slow swings, big damage. Cannot be used with a shield.

Name: Battle Axe
Blurb: The biggest hitter and the slowest. One-handed, with a shield (owner 2026-11-11).

Name: Katana
Blurb: A pair of light curved blades, one in each hand. Very fast, modest hits. No shield.

Name: Wand
Blurb: Fires small magic bolts at range. Light and quick.

Name: Wizard Staff
Blurb: A wizard's staff: slow, heavy bolts from far away. Two-handed, no shield.

Name: Bow
Blurb: Fires arrows from a distance: hold the left or right mouse button to draw (the longer the draw, the further and harder the shot) and let go to shoot. Arrows run out: buy them at the store or make them at the smithy, or pick up the ones you shot (E). Each arrow has a job (F picks which): broadheads for hunting, bodkins through armour, heavy arrows knock back, fire arrows burn. Needs both hands: no shield.

Name: Longbow
Blurb: A tall bow. It draws slower than a bow and you walk slower drawing it, but its arrows go further and hit harder. Hold the left or right mouse button to draw and let go to shoot.

Name: Crossbow
Blurb: The hardest hit and the longest shot. Hold the right mouse button to bring it up and click the left to shoot: every shot is at full power, at once, and it stays ready for as long as you hold it up. But it takes a couple of seconds to load again after each shot.

Name: Fishing Pole
Blurb: A fishing pole. Equip it and click towards the pond. Better poles bite faster and reach rarer fish. Swings as a sword does, for very little damage.

Name: Shield
Blurb: Hold right-click to block blows from the front. A shield has health: holding it up costs 25 a second and a blow on it costs its damage, so it never hurts you. When it runs out it breaks and drops until it has healed to full. Better shields have more health; a higher Defence level heals it faster.

Name: Helmet
Blurb: Protects the head: blows to the head go through it. Arrows to the head do 1.5x damage.

Name: Chestplate
Blurb: Protects the chest and belly: blows to the body go through it.

Name: Shoulders
Blurb: Layered pauldrons: blows to the upper arms go through them.

Name: Gauntlets
Blurb: Armoured gauntlets: blows to the forearms and hands go through them.

Name: Boots
Blurb: Armoured boots: blows to the legs go through them. Better boots also give you more stamina: it lasts longer and returns faster.

Name: Cape
Blurb: A cloak worn over the armour, in the colour of its tier. It is just for looks: it stops nothing and weighs nothing. Capes can be taken off, swapped, bought, sold and dropped like any other gear.

Name: Ring
Blurb: Rings shift damage and defence. Three miscellaneous slots hold any mix of rings and amulets. Every effect is on top of the weapon's own damage range.

Name: Amulet
Blurb: Wears in one of your three miscellaneous slots. Some change the damage rules in strange ways.

Name: Troll Club
Blurb: A troll's heavy wooden club, banded with steel. Slow, crushing swings. Two-handed, no shield.

Name: Spell Book
Blurb: A wizard's spell book, worn on the belt where a knight wears gauntlets. The orb a wizard guards with is as strong as his book: a better book, a stronger orb.
